was.title: A or the: new or already known?
was.short_explanation: Use a / an when you mention something for the first time or mean any one of its kind. Use the when the listener already knows which one: it was mentioned before, it is clear from the situation, or there is only one.
was.tts_text: Use a for something new, and the for something already known.
was.mnemonic: A: any one, new. The: that one, we both know it.

title: Articles: the, a / an or no article
short_explanation: Ask: do we both know which one? Yes, or there is only one (the sun, the best, the Thames, the manager of this shop): the. No, just one of many, or what someone is (She is a nurse; twice a week): a / an. In general, or a name, language, sport, meal, routine place or title (I like music; Doctor Brown; go to school; by bus): no article.
tts_text: Use the when we both know which one. Use a or an for any one, or for a job. Use no article for things in general, names, languages, meals and routine places.
mnemonic: Known or only one: the. Any one, or a job: a. In general, names, titles: nothing.

examples.text: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
The doctor who helped me was very kind.
My uncle is the only owner of this cafe.
Nurses work long hours in many countries.
Doctor Brown is on holiday until Monday.
examples.note: title before a name: no article

He is a pilot, but his brother is a chef.
I love coffee, but the coffee here is cold.
We had breakfast at seven and then went to the market.
Water is essential, but the water in this lake is dirty.
He is the head teacher of our school.
We had a lovely breakfast at the hotel.
She plays the piano, but he plays football.
I went to the school to talk to the head teacher.
She works as the nurse.
The Doctor Brown is waiting for you.

examples.text: She is a best student in the class.

examples.text: I had the breakfast at seven.
He plays a football every Sunday.
The life is not always easy.
Sun rises in the east.
examples.correction: The sun rises in the east.

examples.text: She went to a bed at ten.
examples.correction: She went to bed at ten.
